values.note: Forest Service: 'The campground is managed from June 29th through September 8th, but is available all year around to visitors. Access is dependent upon weather conditions.'
No reservation channel: the Forest Service page offers none and recreation.gov has no listing. 16-day stay limit on National Forest System lands.

note: Kootenai NF (Rexford RD), remote alpine campground on 45-acre Big Therriault Lake in the Tobacco area, 12.5 air miles from Fortine. Reached via improved but unpaved forest roads (final approach FR 7085). --Claude
summary: Forest Service (Kootenai NF), first-come (no reservation channel; not on recreation.gov). Confirmed $10 with the 50% senior/access discount, 10 sites incl. host to 32 ft, vault toilets. Added open all year (managed June 29 - September 8), 16-day limit. Potable water left as recorded: the page contradicts itself (described as an amenity, amenity list says not available). No current alert names it. Note trimmed of restated values.
